digest.component_or_area: mypy strictness configuration and typecheck ratchet
propositions: Enable the safe Mypy strictness flags no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, and warn_unused_ignores globally while deferring disallow_any_generics and disallow_untyped_defs.
warn_redundant_casts flags one redundant int cast at editor.py:515 which should be removed while the adjacent str cast is retained.
warn_unused_ignores reports 24 diagnostics across 20 source files that must each be remediated only in a pinned, fully provisioned canonical CI environment.
A failing ratchet test asserts the four approved flags are enabled and the two deferred flags remain disabled.
Cleanup of unused ignores must preserve, narrow, or document optional- or dependency-contingent suppressions rather than blindly deleting them.
Verification requires the standalone Mypy commands and make typecheck to exit 0 and behavior-adjacent test suites to pass.
